desc:
COMPACT HIGH-PERFORMANCE LOW BACK PRESSURE SUPPRESSOR

The Tisha suppressors represent a breakthrough in compact suppression technology, offering low backpressure, and high muzzle blast suppression in a compact 4.1in K-can suppressor package.

The Tisha punches above its class, outperforming many full-size suppressors in sound reduction, and back pressure.

The Inconel 5.56 Tisha meets or Exceeds Sound and Backpressure Performance of the 5.56 Titanium Tisha.

Material: 718 Inconel

Weight: 15 Oz (no mount)

Overall Length: 4.1 inches (no mount)

Length Added: 3.7 inches added to barrel length with the included direct thread mount (assuming a 0.7-inch barrel thread depth)

Calibers: 5.56mm, All calibers 6mm calibers and below

Performance: The backpressure and Sound Performance Meet or exceed the Titanium 5.56 Tisha

Fully compatible with 1.375×24 hubs, the Inconel Tisha now ships complete with a 1/2-28 Direct Thread Mount. (The Inconel Tisha is out lasting muzzle devices in hard use testing)
